# Bazinga plugins and themes

<!-- This file is generated by `bun run docs`. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Search the Plugins page for "bazinga" to list these in the app.

## Plugins (63)

| Plugin | What it does | On by default |
| ------ | ------------ | ------------- |
| **AccountAgeBadge** | Marks accounts created recently, a common sign of spam and scam accounts. | No |
| **AttachmentScanner** | Warns under messages with attachments that can run code on your computer or hide their real file type. | Yes |
| **AutoReload** | Reloads Discord by itself a few seconds after you turn on or off a plugin that needs it, instead of asking you to. | No |
| **BetterDiscordThemes** | Browse, preview and install every theme from the BetterDiscord theme store. | Yes |
| **BirthdayReminders** | Keep a list of birthdays you enter yourself and get a reminder before and on the day. It only reminds you; it never sends anything. | No |
| **BlockLog** | Shows the tracking and crash-report requests that Bazinga blocked, so you can see it working. | No |
| **BookmarkTags** | Right-click a message to bookmark it with tags, then search and filter your bookmarks and export them as Markdown. | No |
| **CalendarEvents** | Right-click a server to save its scheduled events as a calendar file (.ics) you can open in any calendar app. | No |
| **Censor** | Hides words and phrases you choose in messages, on your screen only. | No |
| **ChannelGallery** | A grid of all the pictures and videos in a channel, from the messages you have loaded. No extra requests are made to find them. | No |
| **ChannelNotes** | Keep private notes for any channel or DM. Adds a notes button to the channel toolbar. | No |
| **ChannelStats** | Shows who is most active in a channel and when, from the messages you have loaded. Nothing is sent anywhere. | No |
| **CollapseLong** | Collapses very long messages. Click a collapsed message to expand it. | No |
| **ColorBlindModes** | Adjusts all colors in Discord for red-weak, green-weak and blue-weak vision, or shows you how they look to someone who has it. | No |
| **ColorLabels** | Right-click a server or channel and give it a color: a dot on the server icon, or colored text for a channel. Only you see it. | No |
| **CopyAsMarkdown** | Right-click a message to copy it as a Markdown quote with the author and a link back. | No |
| **CsvTablePreview** | Shows ```csv code blocks and .csv attachments as tables. | No |
| **DraftCenter** | Lists every message you started typing but did not send, in any channel, so you can finish or discard it. | No |
| **EmojiUsageStats** | Counts the emoji in the messages you send and shows your favorites. The counts stay on this computer. | No |
| **ExifStripWarning** | Warns before you upload a photo that contains your GPS location, and can remove the location without changing the image. | Yes |
| **FocusSessions** | A focus timer for working or studying: it holds back notifications and hides other servers until it ends. | No |
| **GifFrameViewer** | Right-click a GIF to step through it one frame at a time and save any single frame as a picture. | No |
| **HighContrastFocus** | Draws a clear outline around whatever has the keyboard focus, so you can always see where you are when using Tab. | No |
| **HighlightWords** | Highlights words you care about, such as your name or a topic, in every message. Only changes how it looks on your screen. | No |
| **ImageColorPicker** | Right-click a picture and choose Pick a color to read the exact color of any spot and copy its code. | No |
| **ImageCompare** | Right-click two pictures, one after the other, to see them on top of each other with a slider, like before and after. | No |
| **ImpersonationAlert** | Warns when someone's name looks almost the same as one of your friends' names, a common scam trick. | No |
| **InviteInspector** | Right-click a server invite to see how old the server is, who made the invite and how many people are in it, before you join. | No |
| **JsonPrettify** | Shows ```json code blocks as a collapsible tree you can explore. | No |
| **LinkGuard** | Warns before you open links that imitate other sites, hide their real address or use raw IP addresses. Works offline. | Yes |
| **LiveRegionMessages** | Makes screen readers read out new messages in the channel you are looking at, as they arrive. | No |
| **LowEndMode** | Removes blur, shadows and animations to make Discord lighter on slow computers and laptops on battery. | No |
| **MarkdownCheatsheet** | A quick reference for Discord's text formatting, one click away in the title bar. | No |
| **MassMentionShield** | Hides messages that mention many people or @everyone behind a click, so spam does not fill your screen. | No |
| **MathRender** | Shows LaTeX math written between $$ … $$ as formatted equations under the message. | No |
| **MermaidRender** | Draws ```mermaid code blocks (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, charts) as diagrams under the message. | No |
| **MessageTodos** | A to-do list you can add messages to with a right-click. Tasks stay on this computer. | No |
| **PerfOverlay** | Shows frame rate, memory use, page size and blocking tasks in a small overlay. | No |
| **PinSearch** | Adds a button to search a channel's pinned messages by text, author or file name. | No |
| **QRCodeReader** | Right-click an image and choose Scan QR code to read it, with a warning if the link looks like a scam. | No |
| **QuietHours** | Silences desktop notifications and notification sounds during the hours you choose, without changing your status. | No |
| **Readability** | Make messages easier to read: pick a reading font, text size, line spacing, letter spacing and line length. | No |
| **ReadAloud** | Right-click a message to have it read out loud by your computer's own voice. Nothing leaves your computer. | No |
| **ReadingTime** | Shows an estimated reading time next to long messages. | No |
| **RecentChannels** | A title-bar menu with the channels you visited last, so you can jump back with one click. | No |
| **RegexTester** | Adds a box under ```regex code blocks where you can try the pattern on your own text. Patterns run in a separate thread that is stopped if it takes too long. | No |
| **Reminders** | Right-click a message and choose Remind me to get a notification about it later. Reminders stay on this computer. | No |
| **ReplyChainViewer** | Right-click a reply and choose View reply chain to see the whole conversation it answers in one place. | No |
| **ScratchPad** | A notepad you can open from anywhere in Discord. Saved automatically and kept on this computer. | No |
| **ScreenshotMode** | Blurs names, profile pictures and optionally messages with one shortcut, so you can share screenshots safely. | No |
| **ScriptBadge** | Tags messages written in a writing system you do not read, such as Cyrillic or Arabic, so you know why you cannot read them. | No |
| **SecretLeakGuard** | Asks before you send a message that looks like it contains a password, API key, token or card number. Checks only your own outgoing text, on this computer. | Yes |
| **ShortenerExpander** | Right-click a short link (bit.ly and similar) to see where it really leads before you open it. Only asks for the link's headers; no page is loaded. | No |
| **SnippetLibrary** | Save pieces of text you often write and put them in the message box with one click. It never sends anything for you. | No |
| **SpamCollapse** | Folds a message into one faded line when the same person sends the exact same text again right after. | No |
| **SvgPreview** | Shows SVG attachments as pictures in the chat, which Discord does not do. They are shown as plain images, so they cannot run anything. | No |
| **ThemeScheduler** | Switch themes by the time of day, by your system's light or dark setting, or give each server its own theme. | No |
| **ThemeStudio** | Make your own theme by picking colors with a live preview, and change the accent color of the orgeco themes in one place. | No |
| **UploadShrink** | When a picture is over your upload limit, offers to make it smaller so it can be sent. It stays within the limit; it never goes around it. | No |
| **UsageStats** | Shows how much time you spend in each server, counted on this computer while Discord is in front. | No |
| **WorkspaceProfiles** | Group your servers into workspaces like Work or Gaming and switch between them to see only the servers you need. | No |
| **WorldClock** | A title-bar clock showing the time in the time zones you choose. | No |
| **ZalgoFilter** | Tones down 'glitchy' text where dozens of accents are stacked on top of letters and spill over other messages. | No |

## Themes by orgeco (16)

Turn them on under Settings, Themes.

| Theme | Look |
| ----- | ---- |
| **Bazinga Midnight** | Deep navy with warm amber accents. The signature Bazinga look. |
| **Orgeco Neon** | Dark violet with electric cyan, for late-night sessions. |
| **Orgeco Mocha** | Cozy coffee browns with soft peach highlights. |
| **Orgeco Forest** | Deep pine greens with fresh mint accents. |
| **Orgeco Ocean** | Calm deep-sea blues with bright teal accents. |
| **Orgeco Sakura** | A light theme of cherry-blossom pinks and cream. |
| **Orgeco AMOLED** | Pure black for OLED screens, with crisp white text and a subtle red accent. |
| **Orgeco Sunset** | Dusky plum with glowing orange, like the last light of the day. |
| **Orgeco Crimson** | Near-black with bold crimson accents. |
| **Orgeco Gold** | Black and gold, for a premium look. |
| **Orgeco Arctic** | A light theme of icy blues and clean whites. |
| **Orgeco Lavender** | A soft light theme in lavender and lilac. |
| **Orgeco Halloween** | Spooky purples with a pumpkin-orange glow. |
| **Orgeco Winter** | Frosty midnight blues with icy highlights. |
| **Orgeco Spring** | A fresh light theme of new-leaf greens. |
| **Orgeco Summer** | A warm light theme of sunshine and cream. |
